definitions.display_name: NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark or another GB10 system)
definitions.why: GB10 shares the system's memory, and nvidia-smi reports [N/A] for its memory.total, so the name is what identifies it. Every GB10 system is the same chip, whoever built the box, so the id covers them all.
The GPU has HBM of its own, with the Grace CPU's memory coherently attached over NVLink-C2C. Sized as one shared pool, as before, until that is measured on the hardware.

definitions.display_name: NVIDIA Jetson and Thor (Orin, Thor, Tegra)
definitions.why: Integrated GPUs that draw from system memory. The chips differ in architecture, so the architecture comes from the compute capability the GPU reports.
The GPU draws from the same memory as the CPU. How much of it macOS lets the GPU wire is measured separately, through MLX.
